scenarios.description: Canonical text of every script unit over base game + DLC + packs (fnv.script.decompile/1, docs/spec-notes/scripts.md section 3), decoded from the compiled bytes (SCDA), against the independent oracle tools/capture/oracle_script.py, which builds the same text from the shipped source (SCTX). Keyed by unit; text is compared for the 14,511 units that carry both. The known residue (source and bytes that legitimately differ) is listed in scripts.md section 3.6.

The script compiler (fnv_script::compile, docs/spec-notes/script-compiler.md): every unit of base game + DLC + packs that carries both source (SCTX) and compiled bytes (SCDA) is compiled from its source, seeded with its own variable and reference lists, and the SHA-256 of the result is compared with that of the shipped bytes, which the oracle tools/capture/oracle_script.py (compiled) reads without the Rust code. Keyed by unit. The 22 units whose bytes cannot come from their source (forms renamed after compiling, scripts compiled against an older version of another script, reference list entries kept from earlier compiles) are listed in script-compiler.md section 5.
